🚜 Forklift safety. Go to the goods-in desk by dock door 1 (at the back of the warehouse) and pick up the delivery note, then bring it to the shift office . Forklifts are working: keep out of their way.
Spill on the floor
Someone could slip. Signs out, then clean it up.
Trailing cable across a walkway
A trip hazard. Route cables away or cover them.
Fire exit blocked by boxes
In a fire, every second counts. Exits stay clear at all times.
Boxes stacked too high
They can topple onto someone. Stack low and stable.
Fire door wedged open
Fire doors hold back smoke only when they are shut.
Fire extinguisher missing from its bracket
It must be there when it is needed. Report it.
Broken pallet left in the way
Trips and splinters. Take it to the scrap area.
Drawer left open at knee height
Easy to walk into. Close drawers after use.
